facts.claim: A galaxy is a huge collection of gas, dust and billions of stars held together by gravity.

source.title: NASA Space Place: What is a galaxy?
source.quote: A galaxy is a huge collection of gas, dust, and billions of stars and their solar systems, all held together by gravity.

facts.source_sentence: A galaxy is a huge collection of gas, dust, and billions of stars and their solar systems, all held together by gravity.

facts.claim: We live in the Milky Way galaxy; there are so many galaxies that they cannot all be counted yet.

source.title: NASA Space Place: What is a galaxy?
source.quote: It’s a small part of the Milky Way Galaxy. … There are so many, we can’t even count them all yet!

facts.source_sentence: It’s a small part of the Milky Way Galaxy. … There are so many, we can’t even count them all yet!
